stories.title: New Italian restaurant and wine bar coming to Gahanna's Creekside
stories.summary: Micheli's Osteria + Wine Bar, a Florence-inspired casual dining concept, is set to open in Gahanna's Creekside district. The addition continues a wave of new dining options at the redeveloping Mill Street hub.

stories.title: US Marshals find 79 missing children in monthlong Ohio operation
stories.summary: A US Marshals task force recovered 79 missing children during a monthlong operation spanning Columbus, Cleveland and Toledo. In central Ohio, the effort reunited two sisters, aged 13 and 16, who had been missing since 2024 and 2026 respectively.

stories.title: Columbus weather: scattered showers and storms kick off the weekend
stories.summary: Showers and storms are expected across Columbus and central Ohio on Saturday as unsettled weather opens the weekend. Forecasters advise residents to plan around scattered thunderstorms into the afternoon and evening.

stories.title: Wolff: Mercedes could have looked 'idiots' like Ferrari at Madring
stories.summary: Toto Wolff said Mercedes risked looking like 'idiots' in the way Ferrari did, as the team weighed an aggressive one-stop or strategy gamble at the new Madring circuit. The comments came after Ferrari was caught out at the Spanish Grand Prix.

stories.title: FIA confirms Valtteri Bottas punishment after Spanish GP investigation
stories.summary: The FIA handed Valtteri Bottas a penalty following an investigation at the Spanish Grand Prix. Bottas had been eliminated in Q1, and the ruling adds to a turbulent Madring weekend for the Cadillac driver.

stories.title: Verstappen wins pole: Spanish Grand Prix qualifying results
stories.summary: Max Verstappen took pole for the Spanish Grand Prix at the new Madring circuit in Madrid ahead of the Mercedes duo, with George Russell second and Kimi Antonelli third. An early Q1 exit for Carlos Sainz was among the surprises at F1's newest street track.

stories.title: Ohio State vs. Texas: time, channel and where to stream
stories.summary: The Buckeyes take on the Longhorns in Austin on Saturday night, headlined by the quarterback duel between Julian Sayin and Arch Manning. A viewer's guide details kickoff time, ABC broadcast and streaming options.

stories.title: How to watch No. 1 Ohio State vs. No. 4 Texas for free today
stories.summary: Top-ranked Ohio State visits Arch Manning and No. 4 Texas in Austin in a monstrous Week 2 showdown. The how-to-watch guide covers the free streaming options, TV channel and start time for the top-five matchup.

stories.title: Browns' Saturday Dawg Chow: getting ready for the Jaguars
stories.summary: Cleveland's morning roundup sets up Sunday's Week 1 opener in Jacksonville, covering the youth movement in the starting lineup and predictions ahead of the Deshaun Watson-vs-Trevor Lawrence matchup. Watson is 7-0 as a starter against the Jaguars, while Lawrence is 0-2 vs. Cleveland.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei proposes plan to 'slow the pace' of advancing AI
stories.summary: Dario Amodei published an essay urging AI companies to deliberately pace capability improvements, proposing embedded third-party evaluators, industry safety standards and US-China coordination. The essay follows an Anthropic researcher's high-profile resignation and escalating calls from Altman and Musk to slow development.

stories.title: Anthropic grants outside evaluators permanent employee-level access
stories.summary: As part of his 'pace the frontier' plan, Amodei said Anthropic is unilaterally committing to give independent evaluators permanent, employee-level access to the company to verify safety practices and report incidents. He called on governments to require other frontier firms to match the arrangement.

stories.title: Modi and Xi welcome 'steady progress' in India-China ties at bilateral meet
stories.summary: On the sidelines of the Delhi summit, PM Modi and Xi Jinping held a bilateral meeting and welcomed 'steady progress' in repairing relations that have been strained for years. Improving ties between the two Asian giants has broad regional and strategic implications.

stories.title: Modi greets Putin and Xi as BRICS leaders open Delhi summit
stories.summary: A gallery of key moments from the BRICS summit in New Delhi captured PM Modi greeting Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping from arrival to group photos. The summit unites some of the largest economies jockeying for position against US-led pressure.

stories.title: BRICS adopts New Delhi Declaration; Modi holds key bilateral talks
stories.summary: BRICS leaders adopted the New Delhi Declaration on the first day of the summit, alongside Modi's bilateral meetings with Xi Jinping. The declaration seeks to deepen cooperation on trade and global governance among the bloc's members.

stories.title: Xi, Putin and Modi meet at BRICS summit amid US pressure
stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin and Narendra Modi gathered in New Delhi for the BRICS summit as US trade and tariff pressure pushes member states to hedge their bets. The meeting highlights how Washington's America-first posture is driving rivals closer together on trade and security.
